item.title: Craft Brewers Conference: An Anecdotal Experience — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: The Brewers Association’s abdication of responsibility has indirectly nurtured an environment of neglect and dismissiveness, amplifying the distress of intersectional attendees and fortifying barriers of marginalization, thereby rendering their call for diversity a hollow echo in the absence of a parallel commitment to genuine inclusion and equitable execution.

item.title: No Accountability, No Action — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: How the Brewers Association’s response to the issues at Craft Brewers Conference, which impacted marginalized groups, highlights their unwillingness to treat us as equals, and how this impacts the beer community as a whole

item.title: Brewers Association's Second Response to the Collective Petition Letter — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: On August 29th, 2023, the President of the Brewers Association, Bob Pease, sent this email to Beer is for Everyone, as a second response to the Collective Petition letter regarding the Craft Brewers Association.

item.title: Brewing Hope: The Craft Beer Community's Pint-Sized Battle Against Breast Cancer — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: Every October, a wave of pink sweeps across the globe, capturing hearts, minds, and social media feeds. This isn’t just a random aesthetic trend. The color pink, specifically the pink ribbon, has become an emblem of breast cancer awareness. Breast Cancer Awareness Month serves as a beacon, illuminating the importance of understanding, early detection, and support for those affected by the disease.

item.title: Beyond the Feast: Decolonizing Thanksgiving and Beyond — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: Explore the complexities of Thanksgiving from an Indigenous perspective in this insightful article. Learn about the historical context, Indigenous views, and the role of Indigenous-owned breweries in decolonizing the holiday. Gain a deeper understanding of the holiday's impact on Native American communities and discover ways to honor and support Indigenous cultures.

item.title: Mastering Beer: A Conversation with Master Cicerone Jen Blair — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: Explore the inspiring journey of Jen Blair, who has recently achieved the coveted Master Cicerone title, in our exclusive interview. Discover how she overcame challenges and pushed the boundaries in the craft beer industry, advocating for diversity and excellence.

item.title: A Love Letter to Influencers and Businesses: Embracing Ethical Engagement Over Self-Promotion in (Virtual) Communities — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: Explore the delicate balance of ethical self-promotion in virtual communities in this insightful article. Delve into strategies for creating genuine connections, respecting communal values, and fostering mutual support as a content creator or influencer. Learn how to build rapport and deepen audience support through authentic engagement, while understanding the importance of reciprocal relationships in the digital realm.

item.title: Let’s Love Louder Merch Fundraiser — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: The Let’s Love Louder initiative is a call to action to lead with empathy and our hearts. item.title: 2nd Annual Beer is for Everyone Pride Party — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: Join us for the Beer is for Everyone Pride Party during the Craft Brewers Conference in Las Vegas! Enjoy craft beer, food, and fun while supporting LGBTQ+ rights.

item.title: Spotlight on Diversity: A Guide to Must-Attend Events at the Craft Brewers Conference in Las Vegas — Beer is for Everyone
item.description: As the Craft Brewers Conference descends upon Las Vegas, the city is not just a hub for beer enthusiasts but also a focal point for empowering events that celebrate and amplify marginalized voices within the craft beer industry. These events merge advocacy with enjoyment, offering unique experiences that promote diversity and inclusion. Here’s your guide …
